subject: Scout Program — request for trial credit waiver & support
messages:
From: Cassie Nguyen <cassie@scoutlabs.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: partnerships@scoutlabs.io
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Scout Program — inquiry about starter allotment and waiver

Hi Sergio,

Hope you’re well — I run Partnerships at Scout Labs. We’re welcoming a new cohort of 12 early-stage teams in mid-July and Scout provides an integration stipend to each company for platform credits. We’ve been evaluating Redwood for model inference in a few of these startups and would like to centralize the program credits with one vendor.

Two asks:
- Would Redwood consider a temporary waiver on the usual pilot KYC/PO requirement for this cohort? Many teams don’t have procurement set up yet — we’re asking partners for a short-term grace so they can start integrating during the 30-day window.
- Can we get a standard starter package (50k tokens equivalent) per company, with the option to bulk-invoice Scout Labs at month-end?

Attached is a one-page MOU and the cohort timeline. If you’re open, could we align on terms this week? We’re running demos July 5–9.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Cassie Nguyen
Head of Partnerships | Scout Labs
cassie@scoutlabs.io
(415) 555-0187

Attachments: scout_mou_v1.pdf, scout_program_timeline.xlsx
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Cassie Nguyen <cassie@scoutlabs.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scout Program — inquiry about starter allotment and waiver

Hi Cassie — thanks for reaching out and for the clear ask. Really appreciate the MOU and timeline. Quick notes:

- We can typically provide starter credits for accelerator cohorts, but the waiver on procurement/KYC isn’t always automatic. I’ve looped in Marissa (programs) and Vivek (pricing/finance) to review a one-time exception and the invoicing flow you suggested.
- A 50k-token equivalent per company is within the range we support for cohort promos; we’ll validate the total program footprint before committing.

Marissa / Vivek — Cassie is asking for a short-term procurement waiver (no PO up-front) and bulk invoice to Scout Labs at month end. They’d like the credits to be usable starting the week of July 5. Attached MOU lists basic program responsibilities.

Can you advise if finance can accept a 30-day post-provision invoice for an educational cohort, and whether we need any legal redlines?

I’m available for a 20-min sync today or tomorrow if that helps.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager — Startups | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, Cassie Nguyen <cassie@scoutlabs.io>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 10:53:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scout Program — inquiry about starter allotment and waiver

Thanks for the ping, Sergio.

Cassie — love the cohort timing and flow. Quick operational read from Programs & Finance:

- Programs is comfortable provisioning a cohort promo, but we need an MOU signed by Scout Labs and a short acceptance checkbox from each participating startup acknowledging terms (usage policy + no resale). We can provide a simple one-click acceptance link for each team to reduce friction.
- Finance can tolerate a single bulk invoice to Scout Labs net 30, but two conditions: (1) Scout Labs must be a registered sponsor with a valid billing entity (W-9/UBO where applicable), and (2) we require an internal credit cap per company (we recommend 50k tokens as requested, but we’ll place a hard cap to prevent overages).
- Legal wants a one-paragraph amendment to the MOU clarifying liability limits and data handling (SOC2 attestation reference). I attached a short SOC2 stub we can include; this is standard and shouldn’t add delay.

If that works, Sergio — can you confirm we have Scout’s billing info and ask them to sign the updated MOU? Cassie, I can draft the acceptance link template if you share the list of cohort company emails.

Marissa Cole
Director, Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_stub.txt
From: Cassie Nguyen <cassie@scoutlabs.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scout Program — inquiry about starter allotment and waiver

Hi Marissa / Sergio — great, thank you both. Appreciate the flexibility.

We’ll:
- Return a signed and updated MOU by tomorrow with Scout Labs billing entity and W9 attached.
- Share the cohort roster (company emails) by EOD July 4 so you can generate the acceptance links.

One quick follow-up on caps: is it feasible to let teams use an additional 25% of their starter package for evaluation during the demo week (auto-limited, non-billable unless Scout signs off)? That would help teams finish integrations during live demo sessions. If that’s not workable, we’ll keep the cap strict.

If you prefer, we can have a short 15-min call tomorrow (July 8) to finalize language — otherwise I’ll send the signed MOU and roster as attachments.

Thanks again — looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Cassie

Attachments planned: signed_scout_mou.pdf, cohort_roster.csv
